newsitem.title: spain: SOCCER-ROMARIO WITHDRAWS THREAT TO LEAVE VALENCIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMARIO WITHDRAWS THREAT TO LEAVE VALENCIA.

text.p: Brazilian World Cup star Romario on Monday withdrew his threat to leave Valencia just hours after saying that he would not continue at the club under coach Luis Aragones.
Romario had reacted angrily to the news that he was to be dropped for Tuesday's UEFA Cup game with Bayern Munich.
"Either he goes or I do," said Romario of Aragones after the morning training session.
But by early afternoon Romario took back his remarks, saying he accepted the decision and had spoken "hot-headedly".
Aragones defended his team choice, based on the belief that Romario, 30, was not training hard enough.
The coach is under pressure after losing the first two games of the season and has clashed publicly with club chairman Francicso Roig.
But Roig said later he supported the decision to drop the striker.
"The absence of Romario...is the decision of the trainer and the managing committee totally respects and supports it," said the chairman.
